samples.problem: After clean workspace E2E passed, a task report and docs catalog update changed HEAD. The old check treated this as unsafe and forced another E2E even though the changed files were non-package report/index surfaces.
samples.lesson: Report and catalog-only drift should not stale install/package evidence.

samples.problem: Changing validator, diagnose, or clean workspace E2E behavior can alter completion claims and release confidence.
samples.lesson: Validator-chain changes must stay in the highest validation tier.

samples.problem: Package manifest or runtime candidate changes can leak private files or break new-user installation.
samples.lesson: Package and runtime changes remain release-grade even when small.

samples.problem: Acceptance framework and evolution candidate changes can alter what RedCap considers verified or worth future promotion.
samples.lesson: Acceptance and evolution governance changes must not be silently treated as standard or lightweight work.
